CustomField.description: Exchange rate from local currency to USD. Used to compute MRC (USD) and NRC (USD). Enter the rate as: 1 local unit = FX_Rate USD (e.g. 1 HKD = 0.128 USD → enter 0.128).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the exchange rate to USD. For example, if 1 HKD = 0.128 USD, enter 0.128. Leave blank if deal is priced directly in USD.
CustomField.label: FX Rate (to USD)
